items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: But anyhow, I'd go in there to hear Hannah Sylvester sing, too, because I'm still crazy about her singing.

ctx.x: Ethel Waters. It was Ethel Waters. She sang in Baron's. And there was some other girl. But anyhow, I'd go in there to hear Hannah Sylvester sing, too, because I'm still crazy about her singing.
